angleRead.text: I'm still trying to process the A's recent games, especially John Ellis's struggles in the game 4 loss. It's like the whole city is feeling the weight of what we've asked him to carry. I keep thinking about the times I've seen him pitch, the way the crowd erupts when he's on the mound. But now, it's like we're all holding our breath, waiting to see if he can bounce back.
